lines.text:
Chained shut.
I’d better get Grandpa’s things off the bike first.

Grandpa’s old lock pick.
He used to joke it could open any door in the plant.

Room 207.
If the dormitory is still standing, I want to see it.

Same gate, same spot.
Just no one standing here anymore.

Someone slipped up the mountain after his shift.
Grandpa told me a story like that once.
This should get through that chain.

The road’s buried.
Maybe I can get through the dormitory.

Locked too.
Good thing I still have Grandpa’s lock pick.
